items.question: Under the UAE Criminal Procedures Law (Federal Decree by Law No. 38 of 2022), within how many months of the victim learning of the crime and perpetrator can a complaint no longer be accepted?
items.gold: A complaint cannot be accepted after three months from the date the victim became aware of the crime and the perpetrator.
items.fact: Complaint time limit: three months after victim learns crime and perpetrator

items.question: Under the UAE Criminal Procedures Law (Federal Decree by Law No. 38 of 2022), within how many hours must the Public Prosecution question an accused person?
items.gold: The Public Prosecution should question the accused within 24 hours and then order either his arrest or release.
items.fact: Public Prosecution must question accused within 24 hours
